combinations.obstruction: constant shift only: the statistic depends on |F| on the critical line and has no dependence on zeros
every control passes: the three numbers are Farey averages of a function continuous for every F
separation = Blaschke floor, a function of the off-line zeros only (resolved zeros); DH needs log N about 53
the Gram matrix depends on |F(1/2+it)| only; F(s)(s-rho)(s-conj rho)/((s-1+conj rho)(s-1+rho)) has the same Gram matrix with an off-line zero, so no Gram-only statistic can separate
